# Vendor Plugins

These are referenced third-party Blender plugins bundled for FModel Tools dependency resolution.

## io_scene_ueformat
- **Repository**: https://github.com/h4lfheart/UEFormat/tree/blender
- **License**: See io_scene_ueformat/LICENSE.txt
- **Purpose**: Import .uemodel / .ueanim / .uepose files into Blender

## io_scene_psk_psa
- **Repository**: https://github.com/DarklightGames/io_scene_psk_psa
- **License**: See io_scene_psk_psa/LICENSE.txt
- **Purpose**: Import .psk / .psa files into Blender
